name: Veloure
startIntroPart1: Persistent Veloure, your peoples became Masters of the Coasts and Seas. They used that Mastery to carve out an Empire that at one point, could reach out her hand and taste the stars. However, setbacks and stagnation would spell the end of this Plucky Upstart.
startIntroPart2: Protector Azule, you and your peoples stand ready at the braces once more. Will you manage to build an empire that can reach the stars? How will your empire shine through the ages of History?
declaringWar: A Hundred Cities rally against you! Prepare for your demise!
attacked: Don't think we will let this go unanswered!
introduction: I am the Protector of the Confederacy, guiding hand of the Velourin Peoples. Our ports bustle with commerce and our churches echo with prayers. Tell us - what do your people have to offer?
neutralHello: Welcome! Tell us - What brings you here?
hateNo: No wind can stir that Sail!
Is your mind upside down right now?
afterPeace: The winds shall carry us home for now. Farewell
tradeRequest: We stretch out our arm, and offer you this. Let this trade be another source of prosperity for our Peoples!
